zh: 他去拜访荣格，荣格一见面就问他，你对《易经》怎么看？胡适之非常惊讶，他怎么知道《易经》？胡适告诉他，这个我不太相信，这个《易经》好像是魔术和符咒。如果说你居然认为《易经》是魔术和符咒，你有没有尝试过用它来观察我们的生活。胡适点头，点头以后还认为这是魔术和符咒。这时候荣格深深一叹，不断地问他有关《易经》的问题，而且荣格在书里边说，中国的当代学者已经渐渐地走向了西方的科学境界，对他们自己的传统文化已经产生了深深的怀疑。胡适之先生，他基本上属于现代的，被荣格所说的对自己的文化产生了深深怀疑的这样的一群学者，他的功劳很大，但是他的局限也非常明显。
en: This involves a Western concept called the collective unconscious. Even after we entered this personality, everyone did not realize that we entered, but you have entered, so sometimes the unconscious is also said to be subconscious. Then this should have been first proposed by Freud, but his students later also his opponent Jung. I have said several times that the glorious glory of Chinese translation, passing, psychologist Jung, has a little correction to Freud's doctrine. He believes that what is important is not the deep subconscious, what is important is its collective nature, the collective unconscious, this is important.

zh: 那一天，胡适之先生完全不知道荣格对中国文化的研究深度，他不知道这个坐在眼前的荣格，他曾经为有个叫威廉翻译的《易经》的译本，他写了17页的引言，而且这个荣格在这篇引言里边说，中国的《易经》和中国古代的科学，它是紧紧连在一起的，而且比现代的西方科学的因果律高出很多。因果律，靠的只不过是统计，数字统计。如果按照中国古代的智慧，那情况就完全不一样了。譬如荣格指出物极必反，这么个基本法则就高出于西方的以自我为中心的这种人格结构。因为荣格是研究人格的，他也介绍人格结构，他认为《易经》已经改变了西方的对于人格的这种思维方式，中国建立的是另外一种人格。因为胡适比荣格小了十六岁，无论在年龄的辈分上，还是在学术的辈分上，他都不能和荣格相比。
en: Then the personality I am talking about is also a collective unconsciousness. Everyone unconsciously enters a personality structure. This is not floating on the surface, and it is not something that you can reflect by examining your degree and memorizing ancient poems. It is a reef, so there is a saying in the international academic community that Freud found the reef under the waves of the sea, and Jung found the seabed under the reef! This metaphor is relatively large and in-depth. It's a little difficult, let's hear it. It was Freud who found the reef under the waves of human psychology, and Jung found the seabed under the reef.

So why do we say that it is the collective subconscious, when it is formed, it is not formed slowly after our birth.

zh: 我觉得在这个问题上已经大体已经说明，君子人格和其他人格结构的不一样的重要性，到底最后的界限在哪里？中国把君子作为一个理想化的人格结构。那这个平心而论，它几乎把中国文化的好多精华都吸附到自己身上了，都吸附到君子之道里边了。如果了解了君子之道，中国文化的很多成分都能建立，如果没有君子之道，好多都是徒劳的了。
en: Please note that I am talking about the self-portrait of a nation repeatedly appearing in our collective psychological activities, then we also buried a self-portrait of a nation in our hearts, although we do not feel that it exists. Great myths, such as whether you know it or not, each of us Chinese actually have more myths buried in our hearts, such as women replenishing the heavens, reclaiming the sea with Jingwei, Quafu pursuing the sun, Chang 'e rushing to the moon, etc. It is our psychological hometown. A lot of our psychology was slowly established by them as primitive factors, which later became a very complex anthropological project. Many of our modern scholars do not know much about this. They always think that our education can change everything in our minds. They always think that if we read a few books, we can change our personality structure. If we listen to a few stories, we will turn our psychology in reverse. In fact, this is not the case.
